description: React component for a video capture modal, allowing users to record, preview, and upload videos.

classes.name: VideoCaptureModal
classes.description: React functional component for video recording modal with preview and upload functionality.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Initiates video recording using the VideoRecorder instance.

methods.name: saveVideo
methods.description: Uploads the captured video file via FilesController and closes the modal.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops the video recording and saves the video to state.

methods.name: retryRecording
methods.description: Resets the recorder and captured video to allow a new recording.
